Enclose APARs, certificates, NOC, undertaking and Vigilance/Administrative Clearance.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Officers holding analogous posts or Senior Assistant Estate Manager or equivalent posts in Estate Div. in scale Rs. 10750-16750 with 4 years' service in the grade in a Major Port Trust; Degree with PG degree/diploma in Architecture/Town & Country Planning or Degree in Civil Engineering, or Corporate Membership of Institution of Surveyors (India). Experience required: Officers holding analogous posts or Senior Assistant Estate Manager or equivalent posts in the discipline of Estate Div. in the scale of pay of Rs. 10750-16750 with 4 years' service in the grade in a Major Port Trust. Pay: Rs. 60000-180000 (Pre to pre-revised Rs. 13000-18250). Qualification required: Officers holding analogous posts or Asstt. Estate Manager, Gr.I or equivalent posts in Estate Division in scale Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years' service in the grade in a Major Port Trust; Degree with PG degree/diploma in Architecture/Town & Country Planning or Degree in Civil Engineering, or Corporate Membership of Institution of Surveyors (India). Experience required: Officers holding analogous posts or Asstt. Estate Manager, Gr.I or equivalent posts in the discipline of Estate Division in the scale of pay of Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years' service in the grade in a Major Port Trust. Pay: Rs. 50000-160000 (Pre to pre-revised Rs. 10750-16750).

content_sections.heading: How Will DPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection based on eligibility criteria for absorption/deputation.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of APARs for the last five years Attested copies of all educational and experience certificates No-objection Certificate from the respective Ports Undertaking not to withdraw candidature, if selected Vigilance/ Administrative Clearance from the concerned Ports Vigilance report in Annexure-IV format

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DPA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed Bio-Data format (Annexure-III) with a recent passport size photograph. Get the Head of Office certificate on the form signed with seal. Enclose APARs, certificates, NOC, undertaking and Vigilance/Administrative Clearance. Vigilance report to be furnished in the prescribed format (Annexure-IV). Applications are forwarded by the employing Port through proper channel to Deendayal Port Authority, Gandhidham. Applications must reach on or before 07/12/2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Crucial date for determining eligibility is 01/11/2026 Details of any major or minor penalty in the last 10 years may be sent by the forwarding authority with the application Head of Office must certify particulars, vigilance clearance, integrity and no penalty in last 10 years ACRs from 01/04/2021 to 31/03/2026 to be enclosed per Head of Office certificate

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Deputy Estate Manager, 1 Senior Assistant Estate Manager.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-III (Bio-Data proforma) of this circular; also on the Recruitment Section of the official website) and send it to General Administration Deptt., Deendayal Port Authority, Administration Office Building, Post Box No.50, Gandhidham (Kachchh), Gujarat - 370201, by through proper channel, forwarded by the applicant's port, to reach by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 60000-180000 (Pre to pre-revised Rs. 13000-18250) for Deputy Estate Manager, Rs. 50000-160000 (Pre to pre-revised Rs. 10750-16750) for Senior Assistant Estate Manager.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree with a Post Graduate degree/diploma in Architecture/Town & Country Planning or Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognised University/Institution or Corporate Membership of Institution of Surveyors (India); officers of Major Ports holding analogous or feeder posts in Estate discipline with 4 or 5 years' service in the grade. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officers of Major Port Authorities may apply. Applicant must hold analogous or feeder post in the Estate discipline in a Major Port Trust. Applicant undertakes not to withdraw if selected and to accept the posting.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not received through proper channel. Applications received after the last date, without APARs or otherwise incomplete.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection based on eligibility criteria for absorption/deputation.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on Absorption/Deputation basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deendayal Port Authority, Gandhidham (Kachchh), Gujarat.
